Anchors should quote the shape of a real answer, for example that a strong answer names the trade-off they rejected and what it cost, while a weak one describes the team's work with no first-person decision in it.

atoms.obligation: Require interviewers to submit written evidence before the debrief and before they can see anyone else's scores.
atoms.lesson: Whoever speaks first in a debrief sets the anchor, and visible scores pull the rest of the panel toward the loudest opinion. Locked independent submission within twenty-four hours preserves the signal and gives you a defensible record. Evidence means the candidate's own words and specifics, not adjectives: what they said they did, the numbers they gave, and where the answer thinned out under a follow-up probe.

atoms.obligation: Ask every candidate for the same role the same core questions in the same order, allowing follow-up probes.
atoms.lesson: Structured interviews predict performance roughly twice as well as unstructured conversation, and consistency is the main defence if a rejected candidate alleges discrimination. Variation in the questions asked is the thing a claimant's representative looks for first. Keep the core set fixed, allow probing on the answer given, and record any question that had to be changed for an accommodation so it can be shown as an adjustment rather than a deviation.

name: candidate-offer-package
description: Assembles and communicates an offer: base, variable, equity, start date, contingencies and the position on negotiation. Use when a hiring manager wants to make a verbal offer, when the proposed number sits above band, when a candidate holds a competing offer, or when someone asks what the equity is actually worth. Also use to set the counteroffer position before the number is delivered.
expansions: candidate asked what the equity is worth
need approval for an above band offer
verbal offer today written tomorrow
candidate has a competing offer
start date clashes with notice period
offer needs relocation and a sign on
candidate wants the bonus guaranteed
what if references come back badly

atoms.obligation: Check the proposed number against the band and against what current employees at that level in that team already earn.
atoms.lesson: Hiring above the incumbents is how compression starts and how pay gap exposure accumulates, because new hires negotiated in from outside skew toward whoever bargains hardest. New joiners normally land between the band minimum and midpoint unless they arrive fully proven at level. If the case for exceeding the midpoint is real, write down the market evidence, and check whether two or three internal people need moving with them.

atoms.obligation: State every contingency in the written offer and never let a candidate resign on a verbal one.
atoms.lesson: Screening, right-to-work evidence, references and any regulatory clearance must appear as express conditions, otherwise withdrawing after a failed check looks like a change of mind. A candidate who resigns on a verbal assurance and is then dropped has a real claim for the loss they suffered in reliance on it. Send the conditional letter and the contract, and tell the candidate in writing not to resign until conditions clear.

atoms.obligation: Explain each variable and equity component in terms of what is guaranteed, what is at risk and when it becomes real.
atoms.lesson: First-year bonus is normally pro-rated from the start date and paid only if employed on the payment date, which candidates rarely assume. Equity usually carries a one-year cliff, four-year vest and a strike price set from the last valuation, so the headline number is not cash. Say what the plan does on resignation, on dismissal for cause and on a sale, because leaver treatment is where the disputes come from.

atoms.obligation: Agree the decision deadline and the counteroffer position internally before the number is delivered.
atoms.lesson: Decide in advance the ceiling, what is negotiable, sign-on versus base, and what you will do if the current employer counteroffers, so the recruiter is not improvising on a call. Senior candidates reasonably expect two to five days to consider; a same-day exploding deadline reads as pressure and loses the good ones. Route any above-ceiling ask back through the same approver rather than settling it in the moment.

name: reference-check-protocol
description: Runs reference checks that are lawful, consented and actually informative rather than a formality. Use when references are due before an offer is confirmed, when a manager wants to call a mutual contact off the record, when a referee will only confirm dates and title, or when a reference contradicts what the candidate said. Also use for regulated roles that require a defined employment history to be covered.
expansions: manager wants to call a mutual contact
references all came back generic
candidate hasn't told their current boss
need a backchannel reference done properly
what am i allowed to ask a referee
reference contradicted the cv dates
regulated role needs six years covered
referee only confirms dates and title

atoms.obligation: Obtain written consent naming each referee before making any contact, especially with a current employer.
atoms.lesson: Most candidates have not told their current manager they are looking, and one unauthorised call can cost them the job they still hold. Consent should name the individuals and permit the specific contact, since it is also the lawful basis for processing what comes back. Informal backchannel calls to a mutual contact without consent are the single most common way this goes wrong and are hard to defend afterwards.

atoms.obligation: Ask the same behavioural questions the candidate answered and push past adjectives for specific examples.
atoms.lesson: Great and a pleasure to work with tells you nothing. Ask what the person would want them to do differently next time, what conditions they perform worst in, and how they would rate the likelihood of rehiring on a scale. Then stop talking; referees fill silence with the qualification they were hesitating over. Cross-checking a story the candidate told you against the referee's version exposes inflated ownership fast.

atoms.obligation: Record only job-related observations and keep health, family circumstances and personal life out of the notes.
atoms.lesson: Reference notes are personal data the candidate can request, and they are routinely disclosed if a rejection is challenged. Questions or notes touching sickness absence, pregnancy, caring responsibilities or religion convert an ordinary rejection into evidence of discrimination. Health capability is a post-offer matter handled through occupational health, not something to fish for from a former manager, and unsolicited disclosures should be noted as not relied upon.

atoms.obligation: Escalate any discrepancy in dates, job title or reason for leaving before the offer is confirmed.
atoms.lesson: A three-month gap papered over with rounded years, a title one level above what the referee confirms, or a departure described as restructuring where the referee is audibly careful all warrant a direct conversation with the candidate before anything is withdrawn. In regulated sectors the employer must give and obtain a structured reference covering a set lookback period, typically six years, including upheld conduct findings, and cannot rely on a bland confirmation of dates.

name: background-screening-adjudication
description: Decides what to do when a background screening report comes back with a hit, and runs the notice steps that decision requires. Use when a criminal record, credit issue, education mismatch or sanctions match appears on a report, when a candidate disputes what the report says, or when someone asks whether an offer can be withdrawn. Also use to keep withdrawal decisions consistent and documented.
expansions: criminal record showed on the report
credit check flagged for a finance role
candidate disclosed nothing about the conviction
need to send an adverse action letter
screening flagged an education mismatch
candidate disputes the report
how long before we withdraw the offer
sanctions list hit on a common name

atoms.obligation: Assess any record against the nature of the role, the seriousness of the offence and the time elapsed instead of excluding automatically.
atoms.lesson: The defensible approach weighs what the conduct was, how long ago it happened and how it bears on this specific job: a decade-old driving conviction is irrelevant to a desk role and central to a delivery one. Blanket exclusions produce disparate impact findings. Many jurisdictions also bar asking about convictions before a conditional offer, and spent or filtered convictions must be treated as if they never happened.

atoms.obligation: Send a pre-decision notice with a copy of the report and allow a real window to dispute before finalising anything.
atoms.lesson: Where consumer reporting rules apply, the sequence is fixed: a pre-adverse notice enclosing the report and a summary of rights, a genuine waiting period of about five business days for the candidate to correct errors, then a final adverse action notice naming the screening agency and confirming it did not make the decision. Skipping the gap or sending both letters together is the most litigated failure in screening.

atoms.obligation: Confirm identity on any watchlist or sanctions match before treating the record as belonging to the candidate.
atoms.lesson: Sanctions and watchlist screening matches on name strings, so common names generate large volumes of false positives. Resolve using date of birth, middle name, nationality and known addresses through the vendor rather than asking the candidate to prove a negative. Telling a candidate they appeared on a terrorism or sanctions list before the match is confirmed is both defamatory in effect and impossible to walk back.

atoms.obligation: Record the reason for every withdrawal in job-related terms and retain the file for the applicable period.
atoms.lesson: Write down which specific requirement the finding conflicts with, who decided and what was considered in mitigation, because a year later nobody remembers. Retain application and screening records for the statutory retention period, typically at least a year in the United States and through the claim window elsewhere. Periodically compare withdrawal rates by ethnicity, since screening is where adverse impact usually shows up first.

name: work-authorization-verification
description: Runs and maintains right-to-work and employment eligibility checks, including expiry tracking and re-verification. Use when a new starter is onboarding, when a visa or permission is time-limited, when an audit finds missing or late documentation, or when a manager asks whether someone can start before their paperwork clears. Also use when a candidate needs sponsorship or a share code has expired.
expansions: new starter has a visa expiring soon
passport copy taken after the start date
eligibility check is late for a joiner
student visa hour limits
sponsorship needed for this candidate
audit found missing right to work checks
worker's share code has expired
remote hire in another jurisdiction

atoms.obligation: Complete the document check on or before the first day of work and never after the first payroll has run.
atoms.lesson: The statutory protection only exists if the check happened before employment began, or within the very short window the rules allow for completing the employer section. A late check cannot be backdated, and an honest note of the true date is far safer than a false one, which turns a civil penalty into a criminal exposure. Illegal working penalties now reach tens of thousands per worker for a first breach.

atoms.obligation: Inspect original or approved digital evidence, and record the date of the check alongside a clear copy.
atoms.lesson: A copy alone proves nothing about whether anyone looked at the document. Acceptable routes now include an online check using a code the worker generates, a certified identity service provider for holders of certain passports, and in-person inspection of originals. Copies must be legible and unaltered, stored securely and separately from general personnel notes, and the record must show who checked, when, and by which route.

atoms.obligation: Diarise every time-limited permission and re-check it before expiry rather than discovering it afterwards.
atoms.lesson: Set the reminder four to eight weeks ahead so an extension can be filed in time. Where an in-time application is pending, continued work is usually permitted while the decision is outstanding, but that must be confirmed through the employer checking service rather than assumed from the worker's word. If permission actually lapses, work must stop immediately; continuing to roster someone is what converts an administrative slip into a penalty.

atoms.obligation: Apply the same check to everyone and never request extra documents based on appearance, accent or perceived nationality.
atoms.lesson: Demanding a passport from someone who looks foreign while accepting a driving licence and payroll record from someone who does not is document abuse and is separately actionable from any illegal working issue. The worker chooses which acceptable documents to present; the employer may not specify. Run the identical process for every starter including internal transfers, and train the managers who sometimes do this check at remote sites.

name: new-hire-onboarding-plan
description: Builds the plan that gets a new joiner from signed contract to productive, covering pre-start setup, first-week structure, mandatory training and thirty-sixty-ninety day outcomes. Use when a start date is confirmed, when a cohort is joining at once, when a starter spent their first week idle, or when a manager asks what they are supposed to do on day one. Also use for remote joiners in another timezone.
expansions: starter has no laptop on day one
new joiner sat idle all first week
need a thirty sixty ninety plan
manager forgot to arrange a buddy
remote starter in a different timezone
cohort of ten starting monday
what induction training is mandatory
new hire hasn't met their stakeholders

atoms.obligation: Confirm the signed contract, payroll setup and access provisioning are all complete before the start date rather than on it.
atoms.lesson: Payroll cut-off usually falls a week or more before pay day, so a joiner whose bank details arrive on day one may wait a full month for any money, which is a genuine hardship and a terrible first impression. The contract should be signed before work begins, because restrictive covenants and confidentiality terms introduced after someone has started often lack fresh consideration and become difficult to enforce.

atoms.obligation: Give the new joiner written outcomes for the first thirty, sixty and ninety days that match the probation criteria.
atoms.lesson: Early attrition is driven overwhelmingly by unclear expectations rather than by capability. Thirty days should be learning outcomes, sixty should be supervised delivery, ninety should be independent ownership of a defined slice. For a manager hire, add relationship and team-diagnosis milestones. Crucially, these are the same criteria the probation decision will use later, so a starter is never surprised at the review by a standard nobody mentioned.

atoms.obligation: Schedule mandatory compliance and safety induction inside the window the applicable regulation requires and record completion.
atoms.lesson: Health and safety induction belongs on day one for anyone entering an operational site, before they set foot on the floor. Harassment prevention training carries hard deadlines in several jurisdictions, commonly within six months of hire and annually thereafter for supervisors. Completion records are the evidence relied on in a claim and in an inspection, so track them per person with dates rather than as a cohort tick.

atoms.obligation: Assign a named buddy outside the reporting line and hold structured check-ins at week one, week four and week twelve.
atoms.lesson: New joiners will ask a peer the questions they will not ask their manager, so the buddy absorbs the small friction that otherwise accumulates into disengagement. The week four check-in is the one that matters operationally: it is early enough to correct a mismatch in expectations while there is still probation runway, and it is where you find out that the role described at interview is not the role being done.

name: probation-review-decision
description: Reaches and documents a pass, extend or fail decision before a probationary period expires. Use when a probation end date is approaching, when a manager wants a second extension, when no feedback was recorded during the period, or when the date has quietly lapsed. Also use when sickness or a health disclosure has affected the probation period.
expansions: probation ends in two weeks
manager wants to extend again
starter not meeting the bar
no evidence recorded during probation
probation lapsed without a decision
sick leave during the probation period
what notice applies during probation
need a probation review meeting script

atoms.obligation: Diarise the review at least two weeks before the end date and reach a decision before the period expires.
atoms.lesson: If the date passes with no decision, the employee is confirmed in post by conduct and the shorter probationary notice and lighter process fall away. Any extension must be agreed and confirmed in writing before expiry, not retrospectively. Two weeks of runway allows the meeting to be scheduled, the employee to be given notice of it and the right to be accompanied where the outcome could be dismissal.

atoms.obligation: Base the decision on the criteria set at the start and on dated examples rather than on a general impression.
atoms.lesson: A fail supported only by the manager saying it is not working collapses the moment it is challenged. You need the objectives given on day one, the check-in notes at weeks four and eight, and specific incidents with dates. Remember that discrimination and whistleblowing claims require no qualifying service at all, so a poorly evidenced probation dismissal is not risk-free just because the person is new.

atoms.obligation: Check whether the shortfall is linked to health, disability, or a workplace barrier before deciding to end employment.
atoms.lesson: Adjustment duties apply from the first day and during recruitment, so a starter struggling with a system that is inaccessible, or newly diagnosed with a condition they have just disclosed, needs the barrier addressed before capability is judged. The right move is usually to extend, put the adjustment in place and re-measure. Failing to ask the question at all is what makes the eventual dismissal indefensible.

atoms.obligation: Extend only once, in writing, naming the specific gaps, the support offered and a fixed new end date.
atoms.lesson: Repeated extensions are a management failure dressed as patience: they tell the employee the bar is soft, build an expectation of continued employment, and leave you deciding on the same evidence months later with more service accrued. A single extension of four to eight weeks, with two named gaps and scheduled reviews, is enough to see genuine improvement or confirm the decision.

name: performance-improvement-plan
description: Builds and runs a formal improvement plan for an underperforming employee, and keeps it defensible. Use when a manager says they want to start a plan, when targets in a draft plan are vague or outside the employee's control, when a plan has been running for months without a decision, or when a grievance or health issue is raised during one. Also use to write up review meetings.
expansions: manager wants to start a plan monday
improvement plan with vague targets
employee raised a grievance mid plan
plan has been running six months
need measurable targets for a sales rep
employee says the targets are impossible
they improved then slipped back
plan drafted after the decision was made

atoms.obligation: Set targets that are measurable, achievable within the plan period and genuinely within the employee's own control.
atoms.lesson: A quota that depends on inbound leads the employee does not receive, or a delivery date owned by another team, is unachievable by design and reads as a managed exit. Compare against what a competent colleague in the same role and territory actually achieves. Thirty to ninety days is the normal window; anything under a month rarely allows a genuine change in behaviour to show, and anything past a quarter loses focus.

atoms.obligation: Name the support the employer will provide, fix the review dates in advance, and actually hold every review.
atoms.lesson: Support means specifics: coaching hours, a named mentor, a training course booked, a temporary reduction in scope, weekly manager time. Missed reviews are the most common evidential failure of all, because they let the employee say they were set adrift and never told they were still short. Schedule them at the outset, and if one has to move, move it in writing rather than dropping it.

atoms.obligation: Record every review meeting in writing and give the employee a chance to comment on the record.
atoms.lesson: Contemporaneous notes carry far more weight than a summary written later when a decision is being defended. Send the note within a couple of days, invite corrections, and file the employee's response alongside it. Where the process could realistically lead to dismissal, tell the employee they may be accompanied at the meetings; that entitlement is easy to grant and expensive to have overlooked.

atoms.obligation: Treat a grievance or health disclosure raised during the plan as something to resolve rather than something to push through.
atoms.lesson: Complaints about the manager running the plan are common and are not automatically tactical. Decide explicitly whether to pause the plan or run the grievance in parallel with a different decision maker, and record that reasoning. If the plan started shortly after a protected complaint or a disclosure, the sequence itself becomes the claim, so consider an occupational health referral and a change of reviewing manager.

name: review-cycle-calibration
description: Runs the calibration step of a performance cycle so ratings mean the same thing across teams before they are locked. Use when every manager has rated their whole team as exceeding, when ratings vary wildly between similar teams, when a manager defends a score with impressions rather than evidence, or when someone was on leave for part of the period. Also use to check ratings for bias before pay decisions follow.
expansions: every manager rated their team exceeds
calibration session is next week
ratings differ wildly between teams
need a distribution guideline
manager defending a rating with vibes
someone on leave during the review period
new joiner mid cycle rating
bias check before ratings are locked

atoms.obligation: Require each manager to justify a rating against the level definition rather than by comparison with their own other reports.
atoms.lesson: Best on my team is a ranking statement, not a rating, and it is how a strong performer in a weak team gets over-rated while a solid one in a strong team is punished. Force the language of the level rubric: the scope owned, the ambiguity handled without escalation, the influence beyond the immediate team. Managers who cannot produce that evidence usually have not been having performance conversations at all.

atoms.obligation: Compare the rating distribution by gender, ethnicity, tenure and working pattern before any rating is locked.
atoms.lesson: Part-time employees and people returning from parental leave are systematically under-rated, often through availability-flavoured criteria dressed as impact. Because ratings drive pay and promotion, a distribution skew becomes next year's pay gap. Cut the distribution before the session ends, look at any group where the proportion of top ratings differs materially, and require named justification for each case in the affected group.

atoms.obligation: Pro-rate or exclude periods of protected leave instead of rating the absence itself.
atoms.lesson: Someone who worked five months of a twelve-month cycle should be assessed on those five months against a pro-rated expectation, not marked down for the seven they were on maternity, adoption, sick or jury leave. Downgrading for leave is direct discrimination in most jurisdictions and is also visible in the data. Write the pro-rating rule into the cycle guidance so managers are not each inventing their own approach.

atoms.obligation: Record the reason for any rating changed in the room and require the manager to deliver it as their own decision.
atoms.lesson: An employee who hears that their manager wanted to give them more but calibration cut it loses trust in both the manager and the process. The manager owns the final rating and must be able to explain the evidence behind it. Keep a written rationale for every change, because that is exactly what you will need if the rating is appealed or if it drives a promotion or bonus dispute.

name: salary-band-benchmarking
description: Builds or refreshes pay bands from market data and models what applying them costs. Use when bands have not moved for a year or more, when an offer sits above band, when hiring in a new country or a new role family, when survey cuts disagree, or when everyone in a band is bunched at the minimum. Also use to set a rule for geographic differentials.
expansions: counteroffer is above the band
bands haven't moved in two years
need market data for a new role
two survey cuts disagree
hiring in a new country
everyone bunched at the band minimum
geo differential for remote staff
band refresh before the pay round

atoms.obligation: Match roles to benchmarks by the work actually performed and the scope owned, never by job title alone.
atoms.lesson: Titles inflate at different rates across companies, so a title match will systematically mis-price. Match against the survey's scope descriptors: reports, budget, decision rights, technical depth. Use at least two independent sources and reconcile the gap rather than picking the friendlier one, and discard any cut with a thin sample, typically fewer than eight or ten organisations, because small samples swing wildly year to year.

atoms.obligation: Choose an explicit market position for each family and apply it consistently rather than case by case.
atoms.lesson: State the philosophy in one line, for example median on base with upper quartile for scarce engineering skills and total cash at median elsewhere. Silently paying different percentiles to different families is how internal inequity becomes structural and how a pay audit produces an unpleasant surprise. Whatever you choose, write down why, because the first question in any pay dispute is what the band was supposed to represent.

atoms.obligation: Model the cost of lifting everyone below the new minimum before the band is published to managers or candidates.
atoms.lesson: Publishing a floor you do not intend to pay to is worse than having no band at all. Calculate cost to minimum for the whole population, then look at compa-ratio spread and at how many people sit under the eightieth percentile of range penetration. If the total is unaffordable in one go, phase it over two cycles with a written plan, and prioritise the people whose pay lags most relative to peers doing the same work.

atoms.obligation: Set geographic differentials from a stated rule and apply it to relocations as well as new hires.
atoms.lesson: Decide whether you pay on cost of labour in the local market or run a single national rate, then define the zones. The hard cases are existing employees who move: decide in advance whether pay follows location downward, and publish that, because discovering it at the point of a move feels punitive. Remote-hire pricing should reference the market you recruit from, not merely where the person happens to sit.

name: promotion-case-review
description: Assesses promotion nominations against the next level and produces a written rationale for the decision. Use when a manager nominates someone, when a case rests on effort or tenure rather than scope, when two candidates compete for one slot, when a flight risk is asking for a title, or when a declined candidate wants reasons. Also use to check who was not nominated and why.
expansions: manager nominated someone for promotion
case is all effort and no scope
promotion declined and they want reasons
flight risk asking for a title
two candidates one headcount slot
promotion without a role to fill
someone promoted then struggling
write the promotion rationale

atoms.obligation: Test the case against sustained delivery at the next level, not against potential, effort or time served.
atoms.lesson: The workable standard is that the person has already been operating at the target level for roughly two review cycles and the promotion recognises reality. Effort and long hours are not scope. Tenure-based promotion inflates the band population and produces the classic failure where someone is promoted out of the work they were excellent at into a level they cannot yet hold, then managed out within a year.

atoms.obligation: Confirm the organisation has genuine scope and approved budget at the higher level before agreeing the promotion.
atoms.lesson: Promoting someone into a role that does not exist creates a person with a senior title and mid-level work, which is unfair to them and expensive to you. Check the team structure supports the span, check the band cost against the compensation plan, and if the answer is that there is no scope, say so directly and discuss what would create it rather than granting a title as a retention patch.

atoms.obligation: Review who was eligible but not nominated, and ask each manager why, before finalising the slate.
atoms.lesson: Promotion pipelines leak at nomination, not at decision. Part-time employees, recent returners from leave and quieter high performers are routinely invisible because promotion depends on a manager choosing to advocate. Self-nomination processes have their own skew, since propensity to self-advocate varies by gender and background. Pull the eligible list, compare it against the nominated list, and make the manager account for each omission.

atoms.obligation: Give a declined candidate specific gaps and a named re-review date in writing.
atoms.lesson: Vague feedback after a declined promotion is the strongest predictor of a resignation within six months, particularly for people who were told informally that they were close. Name two or three concrete behaviours or scope gaps, say what evidence would close them, and commit to a date at the next cycle. Have the manager deliver it, and file the same rationale so a different reviewer next cycle sees the history.

name: variable-pay-administration
description: Administers a bonus or commission cycle: plan rules, leaver and leave treatment, verification against performance data, and clawback. Use when a rep disputes a commission calculation, when someone left partway through the performance year, when a deal is cancelled after payment, when quota changed mid-year, or when the pool is smaller than what managers promised. Also use before payroll cut-off to verify payments.
expansions: commission calculation disputed by a rep
bonus for someone who left in march
clawback on a cancelled deal
plan document says discretionary
quota was changed mid year
maternity leave and the bonus calculation
bonus pool smaller than accrued
two reps claiming the same deal

atoms.obligation: Publish the plan rules, including leaver treatment and how quota changes are handled, before the performance period starts.
atoms.lesson: Rules introduced after the period has begun are usually unenforceable against the employee and always corrosive. The plan must say whether payment requires employment on the payment date, how good and bad leavers differ, and what happens if territory or quota is reassigned. Labelling a scheme discretionary does not give unlimited freedom either, since a discretion exercised irrationally or contrary to established custom is challengeable.

atoms.obligation: Pro-rate rather than exclude for family and sickness leave, in line with the statutory floor for each type of leave.
atoms.lesson: Excluding a whole maternity absence from a discretionary bonus is unlawful in most jurisdictions at least for the compulsory leave period, and blanket exclusion of family leave is a standard discrimination claim. Where commission forms normal remuneration it also has to be reflected in holiday pay, following the line of case law on that point. Apply the same pro-rating rule to sickness that you apply to any other absence.

atoms.obligation: Verify every calculated payment against the underlying performance data before the payroll cut-off.
atoms.lesson: The recurring errors are deals credited that later cancelled, revenue booked in the wrong period, split credits where two people claim the same account, and manual adjustments nobody logged. Reconcile the commission statement to the source revenue report per person, not in aggregate. Payroll cut-off is typically five to seven working days before pay date, so build the verification window before that, not into it.

atoms.obligation: Apply clawback only where the written plan provides for it and the deduction is separately authorised in writing.
atoms.lesson: Recovering an overpayment or a cancelled-deal commission by simply reducing the next payslip risks an unlawful deduction from wages claim unless the contract or a signed authority permits it. Recovery is also complicated by the fact that tax and social contributions were paid on the gross, so the recoverable amount is not the net the employee received. Agree a repayment schedule in writing and cap it so take-home pay does not collapse.

name: grievance-intake-triage
description: Receives a complaint, decides the route and appoints a decision maker. Use when an employee emails a complaint about their manager, when an anonymous report arrives through a hotline, when a complaint mixes several unrelated allegations, when the complainant asks for confidentiality, or when the complaint names someone in HR. Also use when a grievance arrives just after a warning or while someone is off sick.
expansions: employee emailed a complaint about their manager
anonymous report through the hotline
is this a grievance or just venting
complaint mentions bullying and pay
employee wants it kept confidential
grievance raised after a warning
who investigates when hr is named
grievance while off sick

atoms.obligation: Acknowledge the complaint within a stated timescale and tell the complainant what happens next and roughly when.
atoms.lesson: Acknowledge within three to five working days, name the process being used and the person handling it, and give an indicative timeline. Unreasonable failure to follow a recognised grievance code can increase compensation by up to a quarter in some jurisdictions, and silence is what turns a resolvable issue into a resignation and a constructive dismissal claim. For most non-serious matters the complainant may choose an informal route first.

atoms.obligation: Break the complaint into separate allegation strands and identify which must be investigated regardless of the complainant's wishes.
atoms.lesson: A single email often contains a pay query, a management style complaint and one line about a comment that amounts to harassment. Strand them, because each needs a different route and a different decision maker. Allegations involving harassment, discrimination, safeguarding, a health and safety risk, a regulatory breach or a protected disclosure cannot be dropped simply because the complainant asks to withdraw them.

atoms.obligation: Appoint a decision maker with no involvement in the events and no reporting line to anyone named in the complaint.
atoms.lesson: Independence is the first thing challenged on appeal. If a business partner has already coached the manager being complained about, they are compromised as investigator. When a senior leader or the head of the function is named, commission an external investigator. Identify in advance who will hear an appeal, since it must be someone more senior and uninvolved, and running out of untainted people mid-process is a familiar failure.

atoms.obligation: Explain the practical limits of confidentiality at the first meeting instead of promising secrecy you cannot deliver.
atoms.lesson: The person accused has to know the substance of the case against them to answer it, so total anonymity is rarely possible where the allegation is specific. Say plainly that information will be shared on a need-to-know basis and that the respondent will see the allegations. Anonymised evidence carries less weight, and small teams often make the source obvious from content, so discuss protection from retaliation explicitly.

name: workplace-investigation-report
description: Conducts a misconduct or bullying investigation and writes findings that a decision maker can act on. Use when allegations need testing, when witnesses must be interviewed, when messages or camera footage are being relied on, when a respondent denies everything, or when an investigation has drifted past its terms of reference. Also use to write up findings where evidence conflicts.
expansions: need to interview witnesses this week
allegations of bullying to investigate
messages and footage as evidence
witness afraid of retaliation
write up the investigation findings
respondent denies everything
how do i decide who to believe
investigation dragging past six weeks

atoms.obligation: Write the allegations as specific, dated and testable statements before conducting any interview.
atoms.lesson: Unprofessional behaviour cannot be investigated or answered. Convert it into the form on the fourteenth of March in the warehouse office he said the following words in front of two named colleagues. Agreed written terms of reference then control scope creep, because investigations that wander into everything the respondent has ever done take months, lose focus and hand the respondent a procedural complaint about a moving target.

atoms.obligation: Put every allegation and the evidence supporting it to the respondent, and record their answer to each one.
atoms.lesson: A respondent who has not seen the evidence has not had a fair chance to answer, and that alone can unravel a dismissal. Provide witness statements, redacted where a witness needs protection, and enough of any message thread that context is visible rather than one damning line. If the respondent is suspended, treat suspension as a neutral precaution, keep it short and review it, because prolonged suspension reads as a predetermined outcome.

atoms.obligation: Reach findings on the balance of probabilities and show why each conflict in the evidence was resolved as it was.
atoms.lesson: The standard is more likely than not, not beyond reasonable doubt. Contemporaneous messages, rota records and access logs outweigh recollection months later. Weigh corroboration, internal consistency, whether a witness has a motive to lie, and whether an account changed. Demeanour is a poor guide and should not be the stated reason. Where you cannot decide, say the allegation is not made out rather than leaving it hanging.

atoms.obligation: Report on facts and process and leave the choice of sanction to the disciplinary decision maker.
atoms.lesson: The investigator who also decides the outcome collapses two roles and invites a fairness challenge, so keep them separate wherever headcount allows. Structure the report allegation by allegation: what was alleged, what the evidence was, what the respondent said, what is found and why. Add findings about process or culture separately, since patterns such as an unmanaged team norm often matter more than the individual incident.

name: disciplinary-hearing-prep
description: Prepares and runs a disciplinary hearing and drafts the outcome. Use when a hearing has been scheduled, when deciding what evidence to send in advance, when an employee asks to bring a representative or goes off sick before the date, when judging whether conduct is gross misconduct, or when a previous warning may still be live. Also use to draft the outcome letter and appeal rights.
expansions: hearing scheduled for friday
employee wants a lawyer present
what evidence do we send in advance
employee signed off sick before the hearing
gross misconduct or not
previous warning still live
employee refuses to attend
draft the outcome letter

atoms.obligation: Send the allegations, the evidence bundle and the possible outcomes far enough in advance for the employee to prepare.
atoms.lesson: Two to five working days is the practical floor, and the letter must say plainly that dismissal is a possible outcome where it is, otherwise a dismissal from that hearing is procedurally unfair. Tell the employee they may be accompanied by a colleague or a union representative; legal representation is not normally an entitlement except where the outcome would end a person's ability to practise their profession.

atoms.obligation: Weigh length of service, disciplinary record and any mitigation before selecting a sanction, and compare against past cases.
atoms.lesson: Expired warnings should not be counted; live ones should, and their length must be checked against the policy. Consistency matters: if two people did the same thing last year and received a written warning, dismissing this one needs a reason that survives scrutiny. Mitigation includes provocation, a health condition, an unclear rule and genuine remorse. The test is whether the sanction sits within the range a reasonable employer would choose.

atoms.obligation: Reserve dismissal without notice for conduct that genuinely destroys the trust the employment relationship depends on.
atoms.lesson: Theft, violence, deliberate falsification and serious safety breaches are the classic categories and should be listed in the handbook so nobody is surprised. Summary dismissal removes notice pay, so the bar is high and a mislabelled case turns into wrongful dismissal on top of anything else. Even genuine gross misconduct still requires investigation, a hearing and an appeal; obviousness never excuses skipping the process.

atoms.obligation: Confirm the outcome in writing with the reasons, the effective date and the appeal route and deadline.
atoms.lesson: The letter should state what was found, what was rejected, the sanction, how long any warning remains live and what happens if it is repeated. Give a deadline of around five working days to appeal and name who receives it. The appeal must be heard by someone senior and uninvolved, and decide whether it is a review of the decision or a full rehearing, since that shapes what evidence is reopened.

name: redundancy-consultation-plan
description: Plans and runs a redundancy or reduction-in-force process, from pooling and selection criteria through consultation and alternative roles. Use when roles are being cut or a site is closing, when a selection matrix is being built, when someone in the pool is on parental leave, or when a manager asks whether collective consultation thresholds are triggered. Also use to script the at-risk conversation.
expansions: closing a site with forty roles
need a selection matrix
when must we consult collectively
pooling for one role only
employee on maternity leave in the pool
alternative roles to offer
notify the authorities before notices
script for the at risk meeting

atoms.obligation: Fix the pool and the selection criteria before anyone is named, and make each criterion objectively measurable.
atoms.lesson: Define the pool by interchangeability of work, not by convenience, because a pool of one drawn around a person the manager wants out is the classic unfair selection. Criteria such as skills, qualifications and disciplinary record can work; length of service alone risks age discrimination; attendance scoring must exclude disability-related and pregnancy-related absence. Have two managers score independently and keep the scoring sheets.

atoms.obligation: Begin consultation while proposals are still capable of being changed, and meet the collective thresholds where numbers require it.
atoms.lesson: Collective duties bite on numbers and timing: in the United Kingdom, twenty or more proposed dismissals at one establishment within ninety days triggers thirty days of consultation with elected or union representatives, a hundred or more triggers forty-five days, plus a statutory notification to government. Comparable rules elsewhere include a sixty-day federal notice period for larger layoffs. Missing them exposes the employer to protective awards of up to ninety days pay per employee.

atoms.obligation: Search the whole organisation for suitable alternative roles throughout the consultation and offer them properly.
atoms.lesson: The obligation is continuous, not a one-off list on day one, and it extends to vacancies in other sites and group companies. Employees are entitled to a trial period of around four weeks in an alternative role without losing redundancy rights. Employees on maternity, adoption or shared parental leave, and those recently returned, must be offered suitable vacancies in priority to others, which changes the sequencing of offers.

atoms.obligation: Test the provisionally selected group for adverse impact by age, sex, disability and working pattern before notices are issued.
atoms.lesson: Criteria touching flexibility, availability or recent output disproportionately hit part-timers, carers and people back from leave, so a matrix that looks neutral can produce a selected group that is eighty percent female or overwhelmingly over fifty. Run the comparison between the pool composition and the selected composition, document that you looked, and revisit the scoring where a gap appears rather than proceeding and hoping nobody counts.

name: exit-interview-synthesis
description: Runs exit conversations and converts them into countable themes leadership can act on. Use when resignations cluster in one team, when exit notes are piling up unread, when a leaver will not give the real reason, when regretted attrition is rising, or when a quarterly attrition readout is due. Also use when a manager asks to read what their departing report said.
expansions: resignations clustered in one team
exit interviews sitting unread
leaver won't say the real reason
regretted attrition is rising
manager wants to see the transcript
quarterly attrition readout due
counteroffer or let them go
same reason cited three times

atoms.obligation: Hold the conversation away from the line manager and after the departure decision is genuinely irreversible.
atoms.lesson: Manager-led exit interviews return career development as the reason in almost every case, because nobody criticises the person writing their reference. Use a neutral interviewer from the people function or outside it. A short survey or call three to six weeks after the leave date is often more candid than the last-week conversation, once the person is settled and no longer worried about the handover or the counteroffer conversation.

atoms.obligation: Code every exit against a fixed reason taxonomy so themes can be counted rather than remembered.
atoms.lesson: Use a closed list such as pay, manager, career path, workload, ways of working, relocation and role mismatch, and capture one primary plus contributing factors, then keep the free text as supporting quotes. A single open text box can never be aggregated, which is why exit data usually produces anecdotes instead of evidence. Keep the taxonomy stable across quarters so trends actually mean something.

atoms.obligation: Separate regretted from non-regretted departures before reporting any turnover figure to leadership.
atoms.lesson: A headline turnover rate of twelve percent conceals whether the leavers were your strongest performers or a deliberate performance exit. Report regretted attrition, attrition within twelve months of hire, and attrition by manager, since first-year exits usually point to hiring or onboarding rather than to the market. Suppress any team cell with fewer than about five leavers, or you are effectively naming individuals.

atoms.obligation: Never attribute a quote to a named leaver when feeding themes back to a manager or leadership.
atoms.lesson: Retaliation risk is real and reaches beyond employment: an unfavourable reference or a closed door at a future employer follows a leaver who was quoted. In a team of six the content itself identifies the speaker, so aggregate to a threshold, paraphrase to remove signature details and consider delaying feedback by a cycle. If a leaver alleges harassment or a legal breach, that goes down the grievance route immediately, not into a themes deck.

name: offboarding-and-final-pay
description: Runs the mechanics of a departure: final pay, accrued leave, access removal, property return, notice and post-termination restrictions. Use when a last day is confirmed, when final pay deadlines differ by jurisdiction, when equipment has not come back, when someone is being placed on garden leave, or when a reference request arrives for a dismissed employee. Also use to confirm benefit and pension end dates.
expansions: leaver's last day is friday
accrued holiday to pay out
laptop never came back
final pay deadline in this state
garden leave for a sales lead
reference request for a dismissed employee
do the restrictions still apply
benefits and pension end dates

atoms.obligation: Calculate final pay including accrued untaken leave and any notice pay, and meet the deadline that applies where the person works.
atoms.lesson: Deadlines vary sharply: some jurisdictions require payment on the last day for a dismissal and within seventy-two hours for a resignation, with daily penalties for lateness, while others allow the next ordinary payroll. Accrued untaken statutory leave must be paid; leave taken in excess of accrual can only be recovered if the contract expressly allows the deduction. Include any outstanding expenses and variable pay already earned.

atoms.obligation: Revoke system and building access on the effective date and log the return of every piece of property and data.
atoms.lesson: Coordinate a single joint list with the technology and security teams: accounts, privileged access, shared credentials, building passes, vehicles, devices and any company data on personal equipment. For dismissals, access should be cut during the meeting, not at end of day. Decide in advance what happens to the mailbox and files, since a redirect without notice to correspondents creates its own privacy and continuity problems.

atoms.obligation: Confirm in writing how notice, any garden leave and any post-termination restrictions will operate.
atoms.lesson: Garden leave keeps the employee employed and therefore still bound by duties of good faith and confidentiality, which is why it is used for people with client relationships. Restrictions only hold where they protect a legitimate interest and are no wider in scope, geography and duration than necessary, and several jurisdictions now restrict non-competes for lower earners outright. Say plainly which clauses you consider live.

atoms.obligation: Apply one reference policy consistently and ensure anything you do say is accurate, fair and not misleadingly incomplete.
atoms.lesson: A factual reference confirming dates and job title is the safe default, applied to everyone rather than selectively. Where more is given, the employer owes a duty of care to both the leaver and the recipient, so a positive reference that omits an upheld dishonesty finding can itself create liability. Regulated sectors go further and require disclosure of upheld conduct findings within a defined lookback period.

name: leave-absence-administration
description: Administers statutory and contractual leave and manages long-term absence cases. Use when someone requests parental, family or medical leave, when an absence has run for months, when entitlement is close to exhausted, when a return to work needs planning, or when a manager asks how much contact is appropriate. Also use when leave overlaps with a restructure or a performance process.
expansions: employee asked for parental leave dates
long term sick for four months
leave request without medical evidence
someone exhausted their entitlement
return to work after surgery
keeping in touch days
intermittent absence pattern
leave overlapping with a restructure

atoms.obligation: Confirm entitlement, notice requirements and evidence requirements in writing as soon as leave is requested.
atoms.lesson: Statutory schemes have hard eligibility and notice rules: a common medical leave entitlement runs to twelve weeks for employees with a year of service, a minimum hours threshold and a workplace-size test, with the employer required to designate the leave within a few business days. Maternity schemes elsewhere require notification and a medical certificate by a set week of pregnancy. Getting the designation letter out early is what protects both sides.

atoms.obligation: Track entitlement year, balance used and expected return date on a single record per person.
atoms.lesson: State explicitly whether the entitlement year is a fixed calendar year or a rolling twelve months measured backwards, because the two produce very different balances and the employer must apply one consistently. Shared or split parental arrangements need each block recorded separately. The failure mode is an employee quietly exhausting entitlement while still absent, and a dismissal decision taken without anyone realising protection had already lapsed or still applied.

atoms.obligation: Keep contact during long-term absence proportionate and agreed rather than either intrusive or entirely absent.
atoms.lesson: Agree at the outset who calls whom and how often, typically every two to four weeks, and honour it. Optional keeping-in-touch days exist under several family leave schemes and are paid by agreement without ending the leave. Referral to occupational health should be made with consent and should ask about function, prognosis and adjustments. Phased returns of four to six weeks materially reduce the rate of relapse.

atoms.obligation: Hold medical information separately and share only the functional restrictions with the line manager.
atoms.lesson: Health data is a special category requiring stricter handling and, in several regimes, storage in a file separate from the ordinary personnel record. The manager needs to know that the person cannot lift more than five kilos, cannot work nights for eight weeks and needs a fifteen-minute break every two hours. They do not need the diagnosis, and passing it on is both a data breach and the seed of a discrimination claim.

name: accommodation-request-handling
description: Handles requests for workplace adjustments, from first mention of a barrier through trial, review and any refusal. Use when an employee discloses a condition to their manager, asks for equipment or a change in hours, when an occupational health report arrives, when finance pushes back on cost, or when someone is visibly struggling but has not formally asked. Also use for adjustments during recruitment.
expansions: employee asked for a standing desk
diagnosis disclosed to their manager
request to work from home for health
finance pushing back on the cost
occupational health report arrived
employee struggling but hasn't asked
screen reader for a new system
adjustments needed during interviews

atoms.obligation: Open a discussion as soon as a barrier is raised, without requiring the employee to use any particular words or forms.
atoms.lesson: There is no magic phrase. My back is agony sitting all day, or I keep missing deadlines since the medication changed, is enough to start the duty running. Knowledge held by a line manager or by occupational health is generally treated as knowledge held by the employer, so a manager who quietly absorbs a disclosure creates the exposure. The duty applies to candidates at application and interview as well as employees.

atoms.obligation: Focus the assessment on the workplace barrier and the function affected rather than on the diagnosis itself.
atoms.lesson: A label rarely tells you what to change; two people with the same condition need different adjustments. Ask what part of the job is hard, at what times, and what has helped before. Occupational health questions should be framed around function, prognosis and specific proposed adjustments rather than asking for a medical summary. Fluctuating and episodic conditions need flexible arrangements that can be activated during a flare rather than a single fixed change.

atoms.obligation: Trial an adjustment with a review date whenever the likely effect is uncertain.
atoms.lesson: A four to eight week trial with an agreed measure resolves most disputes without anyone taking a position. Record what changed and whether it worked, because that record is what later supports either making the adjustment permanent or moving to a capability conversation on a sound footing. Refusing outright is much harder to defend than trying something and documenting why it did not work in this role.

atoms.obligation: Justify any refusal on cost or operational grounds with actual evidence rather than assumption.
atoms.lesson: Most adjustments cost little or nothing, and published research consistently puts the median one-off cost in the low hundreds; grant schemes exist in several countries to fund equipment and support workers. Hardship is judged relative to the size and resources of the organisation, so a large employer pleading cost on a modest item will lose. Record the alternatives you considered and why each was rejected, not just the refusal.

name: worker-classification-review
description: Reviews whether people engaged as contractors, consultants, agency workers or interns are correctly classified. Use when a contractor has been embedded for a year or more, when a day-rate consultant is doing a staff role, when an agency worker asks about parity, when a status determination is required, or when an audit flags the size of the contingent population. Also use before converting someone to permanent.
expansions: contractor been with us eighteen months
day rate consultant doing a staff role
agency worker asking about parity
status determination needed
contractor wants a laptop and a badge
unpaid intern over the summer
audit flagged our contractor population
converting a contractor to permanent

atoms.obligation: Assess the real working arrangement in practice rather than the wording of the contract.
atoms.lesson: Tribunals and revenue authorities look at control over how and when work is done, whether a genuine right of substitution exists and is ever used, whether there is an obligation to offer and accept work, and how integrated the person is into the organisation. A substitution clause that has never been exercised carries little weight, and a document describing self-employment while the person is rostered and line-managed like staff will not survive scrutiny.

atoms.obligation: Flag long-tenure contractors performing core continuing work as the highest reclassification exposure.
atoms.lesson: The risk markers compound: more than twelve months on the same engagement, appearing on the organisation chart, holding an internal email address and badge, managing employees, attending performance reviews, and being paid a fixed monthly amount regardless of output. Any one is survivable; four together is a reclassification case. Quantify the exposure as back employment taxes, unpaid leave entitlement and pension contributions, since that is what makes leadership act.

atoms.obligation: Issue a written status determination with reasons and provide a route to disagree where the rules require one.
atoms.lesson: Under off-payroll working rules the client organisation must decide status, take reasonable care in doing so, give the determination and reasons to the worker and the agency, and operate a client-led disagreement process with a response due within about forty-five days. Blanket determinations applied to a whole population without individual assessment fail the reasonable-care test and shift the tax liability back to the client.

atoms.obligation: Track agency worker tenure and equalise pay and basic conditions once the qualifying period is reached.
atoms.lesson: Agency workers commonly acquire the right to the same basic pay, working time and holiday as a directly recruited comparable employee after twelve weeks in the same role, and rights to shared facilities and to be told about internal vacancies from day one. Deliberately rotating assignments or inserting short breaks to defeat the qualifying period is a recognised avoidance pattern with its own penalties, so track weeks per person.

name: working-time-compliance
description: Checks hours, overtime treatment, rest breaks and record keeping against what the law requires. Use when timesheets show excessive hours, when salaried staff are working unpaid overtime, when a rota leaves too little rest between shifts, when someone questions an overtime exemption, or when on-call or missed break time needs to be paid. Also use before publishing a new shift pattern.
expansions: timesheets show fourteen hour days
unpaid overtime for salaried staff
opt out signed under pressure
night workers need health checks
rota gives eight hours between shifts
exempt classification for a coordinator
is on call time paid
meal breaks missed on the shop floor

atoms.obligation: Verify any overtime exemption against the duties actually performed and the salary threshold currently in force.
atoms.lesson: Job title and being paid a salary decide nothing. Exemption normally requires both a salary above a stated threshold and duties that genuinely match an executive, administrative or professional test, which usually means real discretion over significant matters or supervising two or more staff. Misclassification exposes the employer to two or three years of unpaid overtime plus liquidated damages, and coordinator and assistant manager roles are where auditors look first.

atoms.obligation: Record all hours actually worked, including work performed before shift, after shift and during unpaid breaks.
atoms.lesson: Compensable time typically includes required setup, changing into mandated protective equipment, mandatory handovers, working through a lunch break and answering messages after hours where that is expected. The employer carries the record-keeping burden, so where records are missing a reasonable estimate by the employee is usually accepted. A rounding practice is only defensible if it is neutral over time rather than always rounding down.

atoms.obligation: Check every rota against the minimum daily and weekly rest requirements before it is published.
atoms.lesson: Common minimums are eleven consecutive hours of rest in each twenty-four, a full day off each week or two days each fortnight, and an uninterrupted break of at least twenty minutes once a shift exceeds six hours. Quick turnarounds, a late close followed by an early open, are the standard breach and the standard cause of accidents. Fix them in the rota rather than relying on people to swap.

atoms.obligation: Treat any opt-out from the weekly hours limit as individual, voluntary and revocable at the worker's choice.
atoms.lesson: Where a weekly limit applies, it is usually an average of forty-eight hours across a seventeen-week reference period. An opt-out must be in writing from the individual, cannot be bundled into the contract as a condition of being hired, and can be withdrawn on notice of up to three months if the agreement says so, otherwise seven days. Night workers additionally face an average eight-hour cap and are entitled to a free health assessment.

name: nda-triage-review
description: Reviews inbound and outbound confidentiality agreements against the standard position and returns either a signable version or a short redline. Use when a counterparty sends its own NDA before a first meeting, when someone asks whether a mutual NDA can be signed as-is, or when the standard template needs adapting for a specific disclosure. Covers permitted purpose, term, residuals and data room access.
expansions: counterparty sent their own nda
can we sign this nda today
nda before the supplier pitch
mutual or one-way confidentiality agreement
nda term feels too long
residuals clause in their template
need nda for data room access
redline this confidentiality agreement quickly

atoms.obligation: Check whether the disclosure will genuinely run in both directions before accepting a one-way template, and switch the form accordingly.
atoms.lesson: Counterparties send one-way forms by default even when both sides will exchange pricing, roadmaps and volumes. A one-way agreement binds only the recipient, so if your team discloses anything at the second meeting you inherit no protection at all. The practical test is whether anyone on your side will name a figure, show a design or describe a plan. If yes, convert to mutual now rather than papering over it later with a side letter nobody signs.

atoms.obligation: Scope the permitted purpose to the named transaction instead of accepting broad wording about evaluating a business relationship.
atoms.lesson: A purpose clause reading evaluating a potential business relationship lets the recipient reuse your material across unrelated bids, including ones where they compete with you. Name the transaction: evaluating supply of a specific product for a specific tender. A narrow purpose also gives a clean breach argument, because misuse becomes an objective scope question rather than an argument about intent. Pair it with a need-to-know limit covering internal recipients, affiliates and advisers.

atoms.obligation: Match the confidentiality tail to how long the information stays commercially sensitive rather than to a default number.
atoms.lesson: Standard tails run three to five years from disclosure, but the right number depends on content. Pricing and negotiation positions go stale within a year or two, while source code, formulations, customer lists and unpatented know-how should be perpetual or carved out as trade secrets. Watch for tails running from signature rather than from disclosure, which quietly shortens protection for everything shared late in diligence, when the most sensitive material usually moves.

atoms.obligation: Reject residuals clauses permitting unaided memory use, or narrow them so technical and pricing material is excluded.
atoms.lesson: A residuals clause lets the recipient use whatever its people remember without notes, which in effect legalises leakage of your commercial approach into their next project. Consultancies and larger vendors push these hard. If deletion fails, limit the clause to personnel who had authorised access, exclude anything reduced to writing or marked confidential, exclude trade secrets outright, and confirm in terms that it grants no licence under any patent or copyright.

name: msa-redline-negotiation
description: Works through a counterparty master agreement or a returned redline round, prioritising the clauses that actually change risk. Use when a customer or supplier sends marked-up terms, when a negotiation position sheet is needed before a call, or when someone asks which of thirty comments are worth fighting. Produces accept, counter or escalate calls with fallback language ready to paste.
expansions: customer returned redlines on our msa
which comments can we just accept
prep positions before the negotiation call
supplier wants us on their paper
third redline round is stalling
need fallback wording for this clause
summarise what changed since last version
deal desk wants a risk summary

atoms.obligation: Sort every counterparty change into accept, counter with fallback, or escalate before responding to any of them individually.
atoms.lesson: Redline rounds stall because teams answer comments in document order instead of by risk. Triage first: administrative edits such as notice addresses and defined-term tidying accept silently; commercially bounded points such as payment terms, cure periods and audit frequency counter with a pre-approved fallback; only true deviations such as uncapped liability, unilateral termination or IP assignment go to an approver. A twenty-comment turn usually contains three real issues, and naming them shortens the call.

atoms.obligation: Confirm which document controls when an order form, schedule and master agreement conflict, and state that order once.
atoms.lesson: Layered deals fail on order of precedence. Salespeople sign order forms containing terms that contradict the master, and the counterparty template often says the order form prevails, which lets a signature override negotiated liability and intellectual property positions without anyone noticing. Set one precedence clause: master agreement first for legal terms, order form first for commercial terms such as fees, volumes and dates, and a signed amendment required for anything else.

atoms.obligation: Track every open point in one running list with owner and deadline instead of relying on comments in the document.
atoms.lesson: By round three the comment threads hold resolved points, stale proposals and remarks from people who have left the deal. An issues list with clause, our position, their position, business owner and status becomes the negotiation record and prevents the classic regression where a closed point reopens two turns later. It also gives the business a truthful answer to how far apart the parties actually are, which comment counts never do.

atoms.obligation: Read the definitions before the operative clauses, because narrowed definitions move risk more quietly than deleted words.
atoms.lesson: The highest-leverage counterparty edits are usually definitional. Narrowing confidential information to marked material, shrinking affiliate to majority-owned entities, redefining services to exclude implementation, or inserting material into the breach definition each change the deal without touching the clause you were watching. Compare defined terms against the previous version first, then read the clauses that consume them, and check whether any newly defined term appears only once.

name: sow-scope-review
description: Reviews statements of work and change orders for deliverable definition, acceptance and dependency risk. Use when a project manager sends a draft SOW for signature, when a supplier submits a change order mid-project, or when there is an argument about whether something was ever in scope. Focuses on acceptance criteria, assumptions, pricing basis and interaction with the master agreement.
expansions: review this statement of work
supplier says that was out of scope
change order arrived mid project
acceptance criteria look vague
time and materials or fixed price
milestone payments tied to what exactly
sow contradicts the master agreement
project manager wants signature today

atoms.obligation: Require objective acceptance criteria and a defined review window with deemed acceptance for each named deliverable.
atoms.lesson: Scope disputes are nearly always acceptance disputes. Each deliverable needs a testable standard, a named acceptor, a review period of perhaps ten business days, a rejection procedure requiring written reasons, and a cure-and-resubmit loop with a finite number of attempts. Without deemed acceptance the supplier cannot recognise revenue and invoices sit unpaid indefinitely; without written rejection reasons the customer cannot later prove the deliverable failed.

atoms.obligation: Convert supplier assumptions into customer dependencies with owners and dates, or delete them from the document.
atoms.lesson: Assumption lists are where cost overruns are pre-authorised. Wording such as assumes customer resources available as required hands the supplier an automatic change-order claim the moment anything slips. Rewrite each assumption as a specific dependency stating what is needed, from whom, by when, and the consequence of lateness, which should be a documented delay notice at an agreed rate rather than an open-ended right to re-price the whole engagement.

atoms.obligation: State whether the engagement is fixed price or time and materials and align the payment schedule to that choice.
atoms.lesson: The commonest drafting error is a fixed-price statement of work carrying hourly rate cards and an estimated hours table, which in a dispute reads as time and materials with a soft ceiling. Fixed price means milestone payments tied to accepted deliverables with change orders for scope growth. Time and materials means a not-to-exceed figure, a notification threshold at around eighty per cent of it, and monthly timesheet backup supporting each invoice.

atoms.obligation: Check that the statement of work does not silently amend the master agreement it sits underneath.
atoms.lesson: Suppliers routinely paste liability caps, intellectual property licences, warranty disclaimers or governing law into the body of a statement of work, and a precedence clause favouring the statement then overrides negotiated master terms for that project. Read every statement of work for legal terms and strip them, keeping it to scope, deliverables, timeline, fees and personnel. If a project truly needs a different cap, vary it in a signed amendment naming the clause.

name: saas-order-form-review
description: Handles subscription order forms, quotes and pricing schedules, the commercial layer sitting on standard terms. Use when sales sends an order form for legal sign-off, when a customer wants a mid-term upgrade or seat true-up, or when someone needs to know what a renewal will actually cost. Covers term, uplift caps, usage overage and correct contracting entity.
expansions: order form needs sign off today
customer wants mid term seat increase
what happens at renewal pricing
overage charges look uncapped
wrong contracting entity on the quote
multi year discount with annual uplift
ramped pricing across three years
co terminate with existing subscription

atoms.obligation: Cap renewal uplift with a stated percentage or index and fix when the new price must be notified.
atoms.lesson: An order form silent on renewal pricing means list price at renewal, which is how a heavily discounted first year becomes a fifty per cent increase in year two. Negotiate a cap, either a fixed percentage or an inflation index with a ceiling, and require the vendor to notify the renewal price a set number of days before the non-renewal deadline, so the customer can still walk away after seeing the actual number.

atoms.obligation: Confirm the named contracting entity is the entity that will use the service and pay the invoices.
atoms.lesson: Group structures break order forms. If the parent signs but a subsidiary uses the service, the user entity holds no contractual rights and the payer may be unable to recover input tax; if a foreign affiliate signs, withholding tax and a different governing law can apply. Check legal name, registration number and registered address against the public register, and add an affiliate-use clause where several group companies will share the subscription.

atoms.obligation: Define what happens when usage exceeds the committed volume, including the rate and the notice before charges begin.
atoms.lesson: Consumption terms hide the real exposure. Examine the metric definition, since named users differ sharply from concurrent users and application calls from records stored; then the overage rate, which is often undiscounted list price; then whether overage bills automatically or triggers a true-up conversation. Reasonable positions are notification at an agreed threshold, overage charged at the discounted rate, and a right to convert overage into an upgraded commitment.

atoms.obligation: Make added seats or modules co-terminous with the existing subscription end date rather than starting a fresh term.
atoms.lesson: Mid-term additions bought on a new twelve-month term fragment the renewal calendar into several dates, each with its own notice period, and quietly extend lock-in every time something is added. Ask for co-termination with fees pro-rated to the existing end date. Where the vendor refuses, at least align the notice deadlines so that one non-renewal decision can cover the whole estate instead of three separate diary entries.

name: sla-credit-drafting
description: Drafts and reviews service levels, availability commitments and service credit regimes. Use when a customer demands an SLA, when an outage triggers a credit claim, or when someone asks whether the current service levels actually mean anything. Covers measurement windows, exclusions, credit mechanics and the link between chronic failure and a termination right.
expansions: customer is demanding an sla
outage last month credit claim
uptime measured how exactly
service credits are our sole remedy
chronic failure termination right
exclusions swallow the commitment
response time versus resolution time
benchmark against the incumbent supplier

atoms.obligation: Define the measurement window, the excluded downtime and who calculates availability before agreeing any percentage.
atoms.lesson: Availability of 99.9 per cent means roughly forty-three minutes a month or nearly nine hours a year, and the figure is meaningless until the mechanics are settled. Specify the measurement period, preferring monthly because annual averaging absorbs a full-day outage; whether planned maintenance is excluded and how many hours are permitted; whether partial degradation counts as downtime; and whether the supplier monitoring is the sole accepted evidence of performance.

atoms.obligation: Require the supplier to calculate and apply credits automatically rather than making the customer submit a claim.
atoms.lesson: Most credit regimes require a written claim within a short window, often thirty days, and most customers miss it, so credits are never paid and the commitment costs the supplier nothing. The better position is automatic application on the next invoice with a monthly performance report showing measured figures. Where the supplier insists on a claim process, extend the window and start it from delivery of the report rather than from the incident itself.

atoms.obligation: Keep a termination right for chronic or severe failure entirely separate from the service credit regime.
atoms.lesson: Suppliers draft credits as the sole and exclusive remedy for service level failure, which converts a broken service into a small discount. Preserve two escapes: termination for material breach where an outage is serious enough, and a defined chronic failure trigger such as three misses in any rolling six months or one month below an absolute floor, allowing exit without penalty and with full transition assistance at existing rates.

atoms.obligation: Distinguish response, workaround and resolution targets, and tie each to a severity definition with worked examples.
